basic_info.description: A rare San Francisco Compound for the discerning parent or Marina investor. This extraordinary, FULLY VACANT and MOVE-IN ready dual-residence is located in the heart of Marina/Cow Hollowideal for parents investing in their children's future or friends seeking the ultimate city retreat near the Balboa. TWO fully detached homes sit on an oversized lot, separated by a lush garden and expansive deck to entertain on, offering exceptional privacy and prestige. The front house spans 3 levels with a view living room and 3BD/2BA, including a private 1BD/1BA suite with a separate entrance.  A 400 sq ft bonus flex space opens to the gardenideal for a gym, media lounge, or office. A spacious 3-car garage completes the main residence. The rear Carriage House is a 2-level, 3BD home perched above the garden with its own entrance and generous entertaining space. Easy future condo conversion or expansion.  A unique opportunity offering flexibility, independence, and long-term value.
